html:
<button csButton="ghost" type="button" [disabled]="page() <= 1" (click)="change(page() - 1)">
  Previous</button
><span>Page {{ page() }} of {{ pageCount() }}</span
><button
  csButton="ghost"
  type="button"
  [disabled]="page() >= pageCount()"
  (click)="change(page() + 1)"
>
  Next
</button>
